skipped_reasons: chunk 0: 20 of 39 titles skipped: 6 were front-matter/text pages (dedication to Haussmann, title page, running text on hotels/villas/maisons-a-loyer definitions, cost tables) with no plate at all; 14 were plates of HOTEL PRIVE (rue de Valois du Roule by Nolau & Convents, rue de la Victoire by Ruprich-Robert, rue Vanneau by E. Petit, rue de la Baume by Bigle) or HOTELS PRIVES parallele-de-plans sheets and VILLA cost-text pages -- excluded per brief as a different Serie 2/3 typology even though several (e.g. the rue de Valois du Roule elevation and gate/lucarne details) were high-quality scale-barred elevations. Nothing was rejected for poor scan quality or illegibility -- all rejects were typology exclusions or non-plate text pages. || chunk 1: 20 of 39 titles were tome 1 (t. 1) of Vol. 1, which per the plate captions and title page is 'HOTELS PRIVES' (private mansions) -- a different typology than maisons a loyer per the task brief, so all 20 were skipped without individual per-plate review beyond confirming the typology (title page + 2 spot-checked plates, e.g. 'HOTEL PRIVE, Premiere Classe, Boulevart Monceaux, Coupe, par Mr Botrel' and 'HOTELS PRIVES, Troisieme Classe, Nos 10 et 12 Rue de Balzac, Plans, par Mr Azemar'). One additional t.1 page was pure introductory text (p.10), confirming tome 1 is not plate content relevant here. All 19 tome-2 ('Nouvelles Maisons de Paris') plates were maisons a loyer and all were kept: no ornament/plan plates were rejected for illegibility in this chunk. || chunk 2: 12 plates (Vol.1 t.1) were Hôtels Privés (different typology, per instructions) — elevations, plans, sections, and ornament/fireplace details for Rue de Valois-du-Roule, Boulevart Monceaux, Rue de la Victoire, Rue de Turin, Rue de la Baume; all skipped regardless of quality. 2 title/frontispiece pages and 3 text-only pages (Table des Planches, body text on villas/distribution theory, échelles notice) skipped as non-plate content. Among Maisons à Loyer plates: skipped one cellar/sous-sol-only plan (132703768, Deuxième Classe No 88 Rue de Rivoli) in favor of the same building's more informative étages/combles plan; skipped one duplicate upper-floor plan (132703816, No 11 Boulevart de Sébastopol) and one duplicate upper-floor plan (132703842, No 1 Boulevart de Sébastopol) since a plan of each building was already kept and additional floor plans of the same address added little further parcel/light-well information. || chunk 3: 21 of 38 titles skipped: 12 were plates from the 'Hôtel Privé' series (Nos 8 Rue de Valois du Roule; No 8 Rue de Turin; No 47 Rue de la Victoire; No 17 Rue Vanneau; corner Rues de Courcelles & Monceaux) - wrong typology per brief (private townhouses, not maisons à loyer), covering elevations, plans, and interior/fireplace/ironwork details; 4 were plain text pages from the front-matter/text volume (preface, 'Prix d'Estimation' cost tables for hôtels/villas, villa cost breakdown, and a villa-classification text page) with no drawing to extract; 1 was a basement/ground-floor plan of a café-billiard commercial fit-out (No 87 Boul. de Sébastopol) too far from the maison-à-loyer residential typology to be useful; 1 was a shops/basement plan (No 70 Boul. de Sébastopol) redundant with better-documented plans already kept for the same street; 1 (132703763) was the left half of a double-page 'Parallèle de Plans' spread, cropped awkwardly at the gutter - the right half (132703764, kept) carries the plate's title block and a cleaner set of the same kind of comparative plans, so the cropped duplicate was dropped in its favor.
